description: This file contains the implementation of classes related to providing predicates for stream namespace filtering within the Orleans.BroadcastChannel namespace. It defines classes for default predicate provision and constructor-based predicate creation, including methods for pattern matching and dynamic instantiation of predicate objects.

classes.name: DefaultChannelNamespacePredicateProvider
classes.description: Provides default stream namespace predicates based on pattern matching, supporting wildcards, regex, and exact matches.

classes.name: ConstructorChannelNamespacePredicateProvider
classes.description: Provides stream namespace predicates by constructing predicate objects dynamically, supporting pattern formatting and instantiation with optional constructor arguments.

methods.name: TryGetPredicate
methods.description: Attempts to parse a predicate pattern string and outputs the corresponding IChannelNamespacePredicate object if successful.

methods.name: FormatPattern
methods.description: Formats a predicate pattern string for constructing predicate objects, including optional constructor arguments.
